newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: India's NIIT in Sri Lanka venture.
newsitem.headline: India's NIIT in Sri Lanka venture.

text.p: India's leading computer training company NIIT Ltd, is setting up its first education centre in Sri Lanka, its local partner said on Tuesday.
Yakesh Khanna, director of Unisoft Institute of Technology, the local partner, said the new training centre in the capital Colombo would train several hundred students annually.
"The new centre would also address itself to the needs of training end-users and self-employed professionals to enable them to carry out their work more productively," Khanna said in a statement.
The financial details of NIIT's Sri Lankan venture were not immediately available.
NIIT is India's market leader in computer training, with subsidiaries in 12 countries including the United States, Britain, Sweden, France, Germany, Japan and Singapore.
The company said in January that annual revenue from its multimedia development business had surpassed its revenue from computer training courses.
